search_lanes.intent: National CRD VI laws, bills, parliamentary progress, publication, commencement, infringement, and implementation disputes
Article 21c, third-country branch authorisation, reverse solicitation, grandfathering, cross-border lending, booking models, and branch or subsidiary decisions
EBA, ECB, and European Commission standards, guidelines, reporting, SREP, supervisory expectations, and level-two measures implementing CRD VI
Concrete bank, banking-association, borrower, or adviser responses to CRD VI with practical operational, legal, client, capital, or market-access impact

source_groups.rule: Use original announcements and legal materials whenever available. Discover national official domains dynamically and retain verified URLs in the weekly audit.
Open the publisher page and verify date and substance. Treat paywalled material as secondary unless accessible evidence independently supports the facts.
Use for attributable industry positions and implementation concerns, not as proof of enacted law.
Use for practical interpretation with clear attribution. Never treat commentary alone as a country-status authority.

exclusions: Generic Basel III or CRR III coverage without a concrete CRD VI connection
Undated, duplicate, marketing-only, event-registration, or search-result pages
Claims based only on inaccessible snippets
